headline: Magic Carpet tells its own story in the attract
lede: The nine-line rule-wall under the title is gone. One caption line now narrates what the live autopilot demo is actually doing — banking pearls, converting villages, dodging the coven — and cycles core rules one at a time when the demo is quiet, exactly the bar docs/ART.md sets for attract mode.

notes.text: MAGIC CARPET's attract (#2568, #2575): 15 event beats + villager sub-beats captioned, five cadence lines, one on screen at a time; every rule the old wall stated survives.

carpetcheck gained a measured beat floor — replay the demo's own seed cadence and demand >=8 distinct captioned beats (17 measured). The length gate reddened four first-draft texts that would wrap on a phone: measure, don't eyeball.

Two board-hygiene finds: IRON RING's README gap was stale — stun + air-escapable throws shipped weeks ago (#2569) — and a POLISH body that names skipped titles phantom-holds them out of idle-kick (#2571).
